data.name: Achilleo
data.gender_notes: Achilleo is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Achilleus', meaning 'swift', 'unharmed', or 'uninjured'. In Greek mythology, Achilles was a legendary hero of the Trojan War. He was known for his strength, courage, and invulnerability. The name Achilleo carries the meaning “Hero, Invulnerable” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Achilleo usually hope their child will grow to embody hero, invulnerable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing strength, courage, and divine protection.
data.etymology: Achilleo belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Hero, Invulnerable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Achilleo total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The Christian name "Achilleo" preserves the historical, cultural, and mythological significance of its ancient Greek origin, inspiring a sense of strength, heroism, and resilience in those who bear it.
data.spiritual_significance: Bearing the name "Achilleo" transcends beyond personal identification, evoking a spiritual connection to the divine virtues of courage, unwavering faith, and the ability to overcome adversity. It serves as a reminder of the shield of God, protecting and shielding us from harm, and inspiring a spirit of steadfastness, even in the face of trial and hardships.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Achilleo, meaning "The Radiance of God," embodies the inner strength and unwavering faith in the divine, reflecting the belief that even in the face of adversity, God's light and love guide us. This name carries a profound spiritual significance, inspiring one to be a beacon of hope and resilience, trusting in the power of God to illuminate the path ahead.
